# Curry

![Curry, tabular recipe](curry.svg)

**Ingredients (as given):** 1 onion; 2 garlic; 4 little celery sticks; 2 medium carrots; a dash of olive oil; curry paste (quantity not given); tomato paste (quantity not given).

**Method:** Roughly chop the onion, crush the garlic, then 5 sec, speed 6. Add the olive oil (the seasoning stage) and the curry paste; cook 3 min, 100°C, speed 1. Roughly chop the carrots and celery, add them, blend 5 sec, speed 6, then cook 7 min, 100°C, speed 1. Add the tomato paste and simmer 10 min, 100°C, speed 1.

**Notes:** Copy of [Curry stock base](curry-stock-base.md) with the tomato paste layer added; the original is unchanged. Paste amounts to be added.
